summary: The round-trip tests relax the story’s stated absolute tolerance. Runtime results and test-first history remain unverified because execution was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Tests fail before implementation, with test_geometry_aeqd.py failing first and the run recorded.
checks.evidence: No failing execution was independently observed. Author notes cannot establish execution history, and running checks was prohibited in the read-only sandbox.

checks.criterion: Grid matches the PRD formula, explicit-loop oracle, and hand-computed corners and centre for W=5000, D=90.
checks.evidence: Static coverage is present: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:123-134 independently computes coordinates; lines 152-172 assert all corners and the centre. Runtime verification was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Inverse AEQD preserves the centre exactly, including poles, and independently round-trips all specified bodies and latitudes at rtol=1e-10, atol=1e-12.
checks.evidence: Centre and latitude cases are covered at pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:258-327, but every round-trip assertion uses the helper at lines 137-141, which divides coordinates by window width and changes the effective absolute tolerance.

checks.criterion: Independent great-circle distances equal rho within 1e-9 relative for all three radii.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:98-102 implements haversine independently; lines 383-393 compare every grid point with rho using rtol=1e-9 and atol=0. Runtime verification was prohibited.

checks.criterion: Hypothesis tests random centres and offsets within a 5 km window, with a documented longitude range.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/test_geometry_aeqd.py:425-456 generates the required inputs and asserts [-pi, pi), but lines 454 and 456 delegate to the relaxed round-trip helper at lines 137-141.

checks.criterion: Terrain geometry distances use metres on the body sphere, live in geometry.py, and remain separate from radar and model distances.
checks.evidence: pipeline/src/terraluna_pipeline/geometry.py:183-190 computes angular distance as rho/radius; lines 254-261 scale forward coordinates by radius. Imports at lines 9-18 contain only standard-library and NumPy modules. No radar or model distance code is reused.

findings.claim: The shared helper weakens the story’s round-trip absolute tolerance by comparing x/W and y/W instead of the recovered metre coordinates.
findings.evidence: With W=5000 from config/run.yaml:21, these assertions permit absolute error of 5e-9 m rather than the contracted 1e-12 m. For example, a 1e-9 m error at an expected zero would pass this helper. Both the specified-latitude tests and Hypothesis test use it. Restore the contracted comparisons or obtain an explicit contract amendment before accepting the normalized tolerance.
